description: This file implements a plugin for the WPEFramework platform, specifically a StateObserver plugin that interacts with system states via IARM bus events, provides JSON-RPC methods for property value retrieval, listener registration, and handles system state change notifications.

classes.name: StateObserver
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing JSONRPC interface, managing system state subscriptions, property retrieval, and event notifications.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves current values of specified system properties via IARM.

methods.name: registerListeners
methods.description: Registers property names for change notifications.

methods.name: unregisterListeners
methods.description: Unregisters property names from change notifications.

methods.name: setApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Sets the API version number for the plugin.

methods.name: getApiVersionNumber
methods.description: Returns the current API version number.

methods.name: getRegisteredPropertyNames
methods.description: Returns list of registered property names for notifications.

methods.name: onReportStateObserverEvents
methods.description: Event handler for system state change events from IARM bus.

methods.name: notify
methods.description: Sends notifications for registered property changes.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets property name, value, and error in a JSON object.
